sentences.text: I'm Emili, your host.
This podcast is for people who are learning English.
If you are an A1 level learner, don't worry.
I will speak slowly and clearly
so you can understand everything.
In today's episode,
we are going to talk about the Bahamas,
a beautiful country in the Caribbean.
The Bahamas is famous for its white sandy beaches,
clear blue water, and warm weather.
It is a popular place for vacations
and many tourists visit every year.
Let's get started.
Part one, introduction to the Bahamas.
The Bahamas is a country made up of around 700 islands.
It is located in the Atlantic Ocean near Florida
in the United States.
Only about 30 of the islands have people living on them.
The capital city of the Bahamas is Nassau.
Nassau is on New Providence Island
and is the biggest city in the country.
It is famous for its colorful buildings,
beautiful beaches, and historic forts.
The Bahamas has a population of around 400,000 people.
The official language is English,
so it is easy for English learners to travel there.
Part two, geography and climate.
The Bahamas has a tropical climate,
which means it is warm and sunny all year round.
The weather is perfect for swimming,
snorkeling and relaxing on the beach.
The country has many coral reefs,
making it a great place for diving.
Some of the most famous islands in the Bahamas include
New Providence, the island where the capital, Nassau,
is located.
Grand Bahama, known for its national parks
and beautiful nature.
A luthara, famous for its pink sand beaches.
Exuma, known for its swimming pigs.
Yes, real pigs swim in the ocean here.
The Bahamas also experiences hurricane season
from June to November,
so people must be careful during this time.
Part three, Bahamian food.
Food in the Bahamas is delicious
and includes a lot of seafood.
Some of the most popular dishes are,
conch salad, a fresh seafood dish made with raw conch,
lime juice and vegetables.
Grilled fish.
Fish is often cooked on a grill with spices
and served with rice.
Peas and rice, a classic side dish made
with beans, rice and spices.
Coconut's heart.
A sweet pastry made with coconut.
People in the Bahamas love drinking tropical juices,
like mango, pineapple and guava juice.
They also enjoy tea and coffee.
Part four, culture and music.
The Bahamas has a rich culture with music and dancing.
The most famous festival is junk canoe.
Junk canoe is a big street parade
with colorful costumes, drums and dancing.
It happens every year on December 26, boxing day
and January 1st, New Year's Day.
Music in the Bahamas includes goombay,
traditional Bahamian music with drums and singing,
rake and scrape, a style of music played with saws,
drums and guitars.
People in the Bahamas love to celebrate, dance and enjoy life.
Part five, sports and activities.
People in the Bahamas enjoy many outdoor activities.
Some of the most popular sports include basketball.
Many young people love to play basketball.
Football soccer.
The National Football Team competes in international games.
Swimming and diving, the Bahamas is one of the best places
in the world for diving.
Sailing, people love to sail between the islands.
One of the most famous sports events in the Bahamas
is the Bahamas Marathon,
which happens every year in Nassau.
Part six, famous places to visit.
The Bahamas has many beautiful places to visit.
Some of the most famous ones include Paradise Island,
a small island near Nassau with luxury resorts and beaches.
Pig Beach, a special island where pigs swim in the ocean.
Luciah National Park, a park with caves, forests and beaches.
Blue Hole, a deep underwater cave for diving.
Pink Sands Beach, a famous beach with pink colored sand.
The Bahamas is a perfect place for relaxation, adventure
and enjoying nature.
That's all for today's episode.
I hope you learned something new about the Bahamas.
It is a country with beautiful beaches,
delicious food and fun music.
If you ever have the chance to visit, make sure to
try conch salad and coconut tart.
Dance at the Junkanoo Festival.
See the swimming pigs.
of Slow English Podcast.
I hope you enjoyed it and learned some new words in English.
Bye.
